fields.name: threshold
documentation: Minimum input value that this rule applies to.

fields.name: step
documentation: If specified, the input value is rounded to multiples of this step before processing.

fields.name: rounding
documentation: If specified, the rounding mode to apply to the step.

fields.name: min
documentation: If specified, clamps the input value to this value if lesser after rounding.

fields.name: max
documentation: If specified, clamps the input value to this value if greater after rounding.

fields.name: format
documentation: The format string to apply at this threshold. If no components are specified, this can include at-most one numeric format specifier - else, should contain an equal number of format specifiers to elements in the components array.

fields.name: components
documentation: Vector of component descriptions for this rule.

fields.name: div
documentation: If specified, divide the value by this amount and use the resulting quotient. This is applied before modulo division.

fields.name: mod
documentation: If specified, divide the value by this amount and use the resulting remainder. This is applied after quotient division.

fields.name: step
documentation: If specified, round the value to multiples of this step. This is applied after all division.

fields.name: rounding
documentation: If specified, rounding mode to apply to the step.
